newsitem.title: USA: PC-stocks off on jitters about U.S. holiday sales.
newsitem.headline: PC-stocks off on jitters about U.S. holiday sales.

text.p: Shares of personal computer makers fell on jitters that consumer electronics retailers did not have a strong holiday season, fears that were heightened by Tandy Corp's news that it will close some stores.

Analysts also said that fund managers are taking profits in most PC stocks, which have climbed sharply in the past two months. They also pointed out that ironically, the shares that are off most are the firms that are doing well this quarter.
"Tandy is closing some of its stores and it looks like computer sales did not pick up at all," said one trader.
Monday, Tandy said it will phase out Incredible Universe.

Tandy also said it will shut 19 Computer City stores and it will relocate two of its 108 North American stores. It said it plans to focus on the experienced computer users, the small office/home office market and the corporate market.

"There is a general concern about how the consumer PC selling season went in the U.S.," said Eugene Glazer, a Dean Witter analyst, adding that he believes the downtick in stocks of direct PC marketers like Dell Computer Corp and Gateway 2000 and PC leader Compaq, is overblown.
"Companies like Compaq, Dell and Gateway, they are going against the trend," Glazer said.
"Compaq is giving out a pretty positive spin on how business is going for them," Glazer said.
Compaq Computer Corp was off 1-5/8 to 73-1/2, Dell was down 3-07/16 to 52-1/2 and Gateway was off 1-3/4 to 54. AST Research eased 04/16 to 4-05/16 and Apple Computer Inc slipped 1-3/8 to 21-3/4.

Glazer said that many of the consumers of PCs this year are not the first-time buyers that fueled the demand last year, and many sophisticated buyers go to direct sellers of PCs, such as Dell and Gateway. Many consumers are also likely waiting for the new multimedia PCs, expected next week.
On January 8, many PC makers are expected to launch new multimedia PCs, with Intel Corp's new multimedia enhanced Pentium processor.
